notes.title: Celebration & Announcing Within Somnia!
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your support!


I created Contraindication during a time when I was unsure if I would ever be able to create again, so this game was made not with the intentions of being a “good game”, but rather as proof that I can still create. 

I did not think anyone would play it, so all of your kindness has inspired me - I never would have imagined that it would hit 20,002 licenses in a month!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596421/6443fcf2bc00a3a49a2dcf34b612ad41c567f4e1.png"]


Now for the announcement...


While Contraindication was made in 11 days (where the last 3 were frantic coding), this project has been in the works for several years and is very close to my heart.


Within Somnia \[Act Ø] will launch FREE on Steam - please wishlist for support!

[previewyoutube="Dgr1N9eN0z8;full"][/previewyoutube]" \[   ] is company policy.  The lines begin to blur between your identity... A surreal (comedic) horror RPG with a fusion of pixel, hand-drawn, & 3D art. Fall deeper & deeper into sleep while you wait, something lies beneath the surface. "

One last illustration to say goodbye, thank you for everything!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596421/18f6b8d74be80266013c1d0de8b601d7131e44fe.png"]

P.S. you might see them as an easter egg in a future release of Within Somnia ;]
